NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair: Storytelling and Plays
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Storytelling and Plays Story events- Contact Dartanian for any questions and/or interest in any of these events. Living Stories We need as many authors as we can, at least Village recognized Bards. Ye sign up to be a starter for the story and then the rest continue it. Shifts for this last for one Temuairan day, although ye are only required to do two stories during this time and may take a break inbetween stories. As many participants as wish to may come. Story Telling Any author may try to read their work to an audience. We are looking for 9 people to speak (3 per Temuairan week). Please send the work in for review or the name of the work if it can be found in the Library of Loures as well as the times ye can start it (within the festival schedule) and the estimated time of reading. For convenience, a recognized work in the library is a plus. The story will be read and considered for presentation. Plays There are two plays planned but still in the working stages. Unfortunately schedules and necessary actors on these are TBA, since they are in the midst of being worked on. One of the plays planned is mine (Dartanian) and the other is Klaudaryn's originally but I believe has been handed over to Prett. Contact these for more information. Again, contact Dartanian for details.
